articles.title: Nike eyes China growth, with outdoor sports revamp at the center
articles.content: NEW YORK (Reuters) -Nike's push into the booming outdoor recreation market — which will kick off on Monday with the launch of a new trail running shoe — will test whether it can turn a little-known sub-brand into a meaningful growth engine. The sportswear giant plans to unveil a version of its Ultrafly trail running shoe - branded under its outdoor sub-brand, ACG - at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc, an ultramarathon in France that kicks off events on Monday, Nike spokesman Jay Paavonpera said. It is part of Nike's push to reposition ACG as a serious player in performance trail running.

articles.title: Americans are Shouldering Most of Trump's Import Taxes
articles.content: U.S. businesses from Nike to General Motors have so far borne the brunt of costs from President Trump's taxes on imported goods, masking their impact on the economy. Wall Street believes it will soon be consumers' time in the barrel. While foreign companies that ship goods stateside have reduced prices somewhat in response to Trump's tariffs, they shouldered just 14% of total costs through June, according to Goldman Sachs.
